use_case: Demand forecasting and automated reordering: weekly forecasts for about 310,000 SKUs and automatic release of purchase orders to authorized-source suppliers under $250,000
business_owner: IT Distribution vice president of purchasing
vendor_or_model: In-house models on the group data platform (SYS-G6), releasing orders through the ERP
data_categories: Order history including DoD orders (FCI); supplier lead times, prices, and status; reseller and Online Retail demand; no personal information about individuals
affects_individuals: No (suppliers and reseller customers are businesses)
human_in_the_loop: Buyers approve orders of $250,000 or more and any order to a non-authorized source; orders under $250,000 to authorized sources release automatically (enabled 2026-02-02); buyers can stop any order
applicable_laws: N42-R04 (52.204-21(b)(1)) for FCI in the training feed; N42-R05 (52.204-25(b)(1)) and DFARS 252.246-7008(b) for federal-eligible stock; N42-R01 (15 U.S.C. 45(a)) for vendor and product claims

use_case: Checkout fraud screening that scores consumer orders and declines or holds high-risk orders
business_owner: Online Retail director of fraud prevention
vendor_or_model: Fraud screening vendor model plus group features from SYS-G6
data_categories: Order, device, payment token, and address data (personal information)
consequential_decision_category: None (order fulfillment; counsel concluded it is not a CCPA significant decision)
human_in_the_loop: Analysts review held orders; automatic declines only above a high score threshold; consumers can call to have a decline reviewed
applicable_laws: N44-45-R02 (15 U.S.C. 45(a)); N44-45-R06 (CCPA; ADMT rules re-checked before 2027-01-01); state privacy laws (generic)

use_case: Product recommendations and personalized promotions on the storefront and app
data_categories: Browsing and purchase history; app location (sensitive personal information when precise)
human_in_the_loop: Merchandisers set rules and exclusions; consumers can opt out of personalized advertising
applicable_laws: N44-45-R06 (Cal. Code Regs. tit. 11, 7150(b)(1)-(2) risk assessment); N44-45-R02 (15 U.S.C. 45(a))
status: In production; CCPA risk assessment due 2027-06-30

use_case: Customer service generative AI assistant for order status, returns, and product questions
business_owner: Online Retail vice president of customer care
vendor_or_model: Hosted large language model from a third-party provider (no-training, zero-retention terms) with retrieval from order systems
data_categories: Order history and contact details after identity checks; product content
human_in_the_loop: Disclosed as AI; hands off to an agent on request or low confidence; cannot issue refunds above $100 or change addresses
applicable_laws: N44-45-R02 (15 U.S.C. 45(a)); N44-45-R06 (CCPA); POL-04 4.4 (no card data in chat)
status: In production; one-time code before order details due 2026-12-31

use_case: DC labor management: productivity scoring, task allocation, and coaching flags for DC workers
data_categories: Scan events, task times, attendance, and worker identifiers (employee personal information)
human_in_the_loop: Supervisors decide all coaching and discipline; scores may not be the sole basis for discipline (condition); workers can contest scores
applicable_laws: Title VII disparate impact (EEOC four-fifths rule of thumb, 29 CFR 1607.4(D)); state warehouse quota and labor laws (generic; not analyzed in this sample); CCPA ADMT rules would apply to California employees (none at DCs today); Colorado SB26-189 if workers are in Colorado (none today)
status: In production; expansion of automated task allocation paused

use_case: Route and load optimization for the private fleet and carrier tendering
data_categories: Shipment, location, and driver duty-status data
human_in_the_loop: Dispatchers approve plans; drivers can refuse unsafe routes; plans must respect hours-of-service limits
applicable_laws: Hours-of-service rules for drivers (49 CFR Part 395); N42-R01 (15 U.S.C. 45(a))

use_case: Marketplace seller risk scoring and counterfeit listing detection
vendor_or_model: In-house models on SYS-G6 plus an identity verification vendor
data_categories: Seller identity and bank data (INFORM Act data), listings, images, complaints
human_in_the_loop: Analysts decide suspensions and takedowns; sellers get notice and the 10-day opportunity the Act requires
status: In production; INFORM data use limits under review (POAM-020)

use_case: Computer vision at receiving to flag resealed or altered packaging
human_in_the_loop: Receiving staff inspect every flagged unit; the tool never releases a unit
applicable_laws: DFARS 252.246-7008(c) (supports traceability); C-SCRM plan (NIST SP 800-161 Rev. 1)
